questions: Do you have a fever or any blood/mucus in your diarrhea?
Are you currently pregnant, or could you be pregnant?
How many days have your symptoms been going on?
Have you been able to keep fluids down, and are you urinating normally (any signs of dehydration)?
Have you eaten any suspicious food or had sick contacts (someone else around you with similar diarrhea/vomiting) in the 1–3 days before symptoms started?
Have you taken any antibiotics in the past 1–3 months?
Have you noticed severe dehydration signs such as dizziness on standing, very dry mouth, or inability to keep any liquids down?
What is your current temperature (or have you had any chills or feeling feverish)?
About how many times per day are you having diarrhea, and is it watery or just loose?
Have you noticed any severe right-lower-quadrant pain or pain that’s worsening or localized (possible appendicitis), or is the abdominal discomfort crampy and diffuse?
answers: I don’t think I’ve had a fever. And I haven’t noticed any blood or mucus in my diarrhea.
No, I’m not pregnant, and I don’t think I could be pregnant.

No, I haven’t eaten anything suspicious that I know of, and I don’t think I had sick contacts with someone else having similar diarrhea or vomiting.
No, I haven’t taken any antibiotics in the past 1–3 months.
I don’t think I’m too dizzy when I stand, and my mouth doesn’t feel extremely dry. I can keep liquids down, but I still feel nauseous and my urine is pretty dark.
I don’t know my exact temperature, and I haven’t really had chills or felt feverish.
I’m having it **more often than usual**, and it’s pretty **loose/diarrhea**. I can’t give an exact number of times per day right now.
No severe right-lower-quadrant pain. It feels more like **crampy stomach pain** with discomfort around **mid-abdomen** and it’s not radiating.
